grh_a88ac72f73c9f4505d16.title: Paolo Framed for Jewel Robbery
paragraphs: Paolo, a young man Slate knows from an earlier brush with crime, is accused of a jewel robbery and then found shot. grh_a82fd42795a169478a5b.title: To Whom It May Concern
paragraphs: After a company suspects that valuable designs are leaking, one of its owners begins secretly bugging employees' telephones. The surveillance finds personal weaknesses rather than proof, yet suspicion spreads until he bugs his own brother and family members begin spying on one another in return. Every new recording produces another secret and another reason to distrust somebody, while outsiders exploit the same techniques for their own advantage. By the end, the original security investigation has become a self-feeding system of blackmail, threats and armed paranoia in which nobody can trust anybody else.

The cast includes Dan Ocko, Larry Haines, Natalie Priest, Robert Dryden, and Neal Pultz. Other credited names include Warren Somerville as director, Bill Gammie as writer, and Fred Foy as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 20 minutes.
